terra.problem: “David thanks the city” happens after David is anointed at Hebron. The passage says he sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead, but does not say they delivered his message there.
Some wording is above a 5th-grade reading level, including “assembly,” “deliverance,” “anointed,” and “had not had relations with a man.” Simpler wording would make the card easier to understand.
